verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM ships built-in AI Agents that users can delegate tasks to, with configurable agent workflows and custom agent skills documented, plus a GitHub description explicitly touting 'use AI Agents' as a core feature. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of agent task delegation specifically (community evidence focuses mostly on chat/RAG use, not agentic task execution) and deeper detail on agent capabilities/limits.
